title: Aisma API and MCP Server for AI Video Editing
excerpt: Connect AI assistants and your own apps to Aisma: a remote MCP server and REST API to edit videos you already shot, with OAuth, API keys and credit caps.
content_html:
Aisma / For developers

The Aisma API and MCP server.
Edit video from your code.

Scripts, automation tools and AI agents can edit a video you already shot, the way the app does: upload a clip of 2–60 seconds, describe the change in plain words, get the price in credits, start the edit and fetch the private result. It’s the same account, the same credits and the same Library as the app.

Read the OpenAPI referenceConnect an AI assistant

What stays

  • Your account, credits and Library
  • The app’s prices, quoted before you start
  • Your original framing and audio

What changes

  • Whatever your request asks for, in plain words
  • A face, a whole person, an outfit or a product
  • The background, a new style or an effect

What you bring

An Aisma account signed in with Google, Apple or email, credits, and a clip of 2–60 seconds (MP4 or MOV, up to 500 MB). Photos are optional, up to 10.

Two ways in

One editor.
Two ways to reach it.

REST API

JSON over HTTPS under https://api.aisma.ai/v1, described by an OpenAPI 3.1 document. Upload, price, start, follow and fetch an edit with a personal API key.

Webhooks tell your server when an edit finishes, fails or is settled.

Open the OpenAPI document

MCP server

A remote MCP server at https://api.aisma.ai/mcp for AI assistants and agents. It speaks Streamable HTTP and signs in with OAuth.

Nine tools cover the whole edit, and the assistant asks you before it spends credits.

Set up the MCP server

Same account, same credits

Edits started through the API use your Aisma credits at the app’s prices and land in your Library beside the ones you made in the app.

The API never buys credits. You top up in Aisma.

See pricing

Private, with your limits

Uploads and results stay private to your account, and every link to them is signed and short-lived.

Each key and connected app has its own permissions and limits you can change. Revoke it and it stops working at once.

Read the privacy policy

How an edit runs

Upload, price, start.
Then fetch the result.

An edit takes the same path in the app, over REST and over MCP. Nothing is charged until you start a quoted edit, and the finished video lands privately in your Library.

The steps of an edit with their REST calls and MCP tools
StepRESTMCP toolWhat happens
UploadPOST /v1/uploadscreate_uploadReturns a one-time upload link. PUT the file to it with the headers it names.
Or reusePOST /v1/assets/from-libraryuse_library_videoTakes a finished edit from your Library as the source instead.
CheckGET /v1/assets/{id}get_assetWait until the upload is ready; quote only with ready files.
PricePOST /v1/quotesquote_editPrices your request, photos and quality in credits. Nothing is charged; the price holds for 15 minutes.
StartPOST /v1/jobsstart_editStarts the quoted edit and reserves its credits. An Idempotency-Key makes a retry return the same edit.
FollowGET /v1/jobs/{id}get_jobStatus and confirmed progress, which reaches 100 only once the edited video is stored.
FetchPOST /v1/jobs/{id}/resultget_result_linkA private link to the finished video, valid for one hour.

REST quickstart

Four steps.
One edited clip.

Send your key as a bearer token and name your client in the User-Agent header. Bodies are JSON, ids are UUIDs and times are ISO 8601. The request below is the one behind the snowy forest at the top of this page.

# 1. Ask for an upload link
curl -X POST https://api.aisma.ai/v1/uploads \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AISMA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"kind":"video","contentType":"video/mp4","bytes":12345678}'
# Then PUT the file to uploadUrl with the headers it returns
curl -X PUT "$UPLOAD_URL" \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Content-Type: video/mp4" \
  --data-binary @clip.mp4

# 2. Price the edit once GET /v1/assets/ASSET_ID says ready (nothing is charged)
curl -X POST https://api.aisma.ai/v1/quotes \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AISMA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"sourceId":"ASSET_ID","brief":"change the background to a snowy forest","quality":"720p"}'

# 3. Start it; the Idempotency-Key makes a retry return the same edit
curl -X POST https://api.aisma.ai/v1/jobs \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AISMA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: first-edit-0001" \
  -d '{"quoteId":"QUOTE_ID"}'

# 4. When GET /v1/jobs/JOB_ID says resultReady, get the one-hour link
curl -X POST https://api.aisma.ai/v1/jobs/JOB_ID/result \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AISMA_API_KEY"

While Aisma is still checking a new clip, a quote answers 202 with retryAfterMs; ask again after that delay. Follow an edit no more often than every 10 seconds, or register a webhook and wait for it.

MCP server

Connect your assistant
with one address.

Add https://api.aisma.ai/mcp as a remote MCP server or custom connector in any assistant or coding agent that supports them. The server speaks Streamable HTTP without sessions and answers the protocol revisions 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18 and 2025-03-26.

Setting up Claude, Cursor or VS Code? The video editing MCP server page walks through each client, every tool and what an agent can edit.

The first call opens Aisma’s sign-in page (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration). There you choose what the connection may do and, if you like, a monthly credit limit; change its limits or disconnect it any time under Profile → Settings & help → Connected apps and keys.

Use Aisma in ChatGPT: start your prompt with “Aisma”, connect your Aisma account when ChatGPT prompts you the first time and attach a video with optional reference photos. Describe the edit and answer any preparation questions. Confirm the edit before it starts. You can also reuse a finished video from your Aisma Library.

Our guide to editing video in ChatGPT explains connecting, attaching files and following an edit.

{
  "mcpServers": {
    "aisma": { "url": "https://api.aisma.ai/mcp" }
  }
}

Prefer a key? Send it in the Authorization header as Bearer aisma_live_… instead of signing in.

Standard MCP clients use create_upload and PUT the file to its signed HTTPS link. The Aisma plugin in ChatGPT copies video and photos attached in the chat with import_chat_media, then waits for get_asset to report them ready. An assistant can also use finished videos from your Aisma Library.

MCP tools

Nine standard MCP tools.
Confirm before credits.

Every tool has a title, read-only or destructive hints and an output schema, and answers with structured content. start_edit is marked destructive and tells the assistant to confirm the price with you first; asking it twice for the same quote returns the same edit.

The Aisma plugin in ChatGPT replaces create_upload with import_chat_media for files attached in the chat. When a preparation preview is available, start_preview and get_preview prepare the edit, answer_preview records your choices, and start_prepared_edit starts only after you confirm the edit. The ordinary quote path remains available when this account has no previews left.

The MCP tools, what each does and whether it spends credits
ToolWhat it doesSpends credits
create_uploadA one-time HTTPS link to upload a video or photo. The assistant PUTs the file itself.No
get_assetWhere an upload stands: uploading, checking, ready, failed or expired.No
use_library_videoMakes a finished video from your Library the source of a new edit.No
quote_editPrices an edit in credits. Nothing is charged, and the price holds for 15 minutes.No
start_editStarts a quoted edit and reserves its credits, after you confirm the price.Yes, after you confirm
get_jobStatus and confirmed progress of an edit.No
list_libraryYour Library, newest first.No
get_result_linkA private link to the finished video, valid for one hour.No
get_accountYour credit balance and this connection’s limits, with what is left of each.No

Sign-in

API keys or OAuth.
Your caps either way.

Personal API keys: create one in the web app under Profile → Settings & help → Connected apps and keys. A key starts with aisma_live_ and is shown once; Aisma keeps only its hash. Send it in the Authorization header as Bearer aisma_live_…, never in a link.

Connected apps: MCP clients and other apps sign in with OAuth 2.1 (authorization code with PKCE, rotating refresh tokens and dynamic client registration). Discovery starts at https://api.aisma.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.

Each key and connected app has its own scopes and limits. Revoke a key or disconnect an app and it stops working at once.

Keys and connected apps need an account signed in with Google, Apple or email. Guest profiles can’t hold them.

The scopes a key or connected app can hold
ScopeAllows
media:writeUpload videos and photos, and use Library videos as sources
media:readCheck uploads and get links to finished videos
jobs:readSee edit status and the Library
jobs:writeGet prices and start edits that spend credits
account:readSee the credit balance and limits
webhooks:writeRegister webhook endpoints

Limits

What one edit
can carry.

Video
One clip of 2–60 seconds, up to 500 MB, MP4 or MOV, or a finished video from your Library.

Photos
Up to 10 per edit, JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB each. Call them “photo 1”, “photo 2” in the request.

Request
Your own words, up to 2,000 characters.

Result
720p by default or 1080p, with your original framing and audio, private in your Library.

Content
Aisma may refuse requests involving nudity or sexual content. An edit declined by this check is not charged: its issue has the code content_declined.

Price
Credits, as in the app, quoted before you start. Current rates are on the pricing page.

Limits
Generous by default and yours to change per key or connected app: credit limits (none until you set one), edits started an hour, edits at once and uploads an hour (Library sources count), under Profile → Settings & help → Connected apps and keys. GET /v1/account returns the limits in effect and what is left. A refused call isn’t counted.

Daily uploads
Each account adds a set number of videos (Library sources count) and photos a day, more after buying credits.

Headers
Every response carries X-Request-Id and Aisma-Version; limited calls add RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset.

User-Agent
Python's built-in urllib with its default User-Agent (Python-urllib/…) and Perl's libwww-perl default can be refused at the edge with HTTP 403 "error code: 1010": set your own User-Agent, such as my-app/1.0.

Version
2026-10-19, in the Aisma-Version header.

Webhooks

Hear back
when an edit is done.

Register an HTTPS endpoint with POST /v1/webhooks (scope webhooks:write). Aisma sends job.completed, job.failed and job.settled for the edits the API started.

Deliveries follow Standard Webhooks: each carries webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature, an HMAC-SHA256 of the id, the timestamp and the body, signed with the secret you get once when you register. A failed delivery is retried for up to 24 hours. Following the edit with GET /v1/jobs/{id} stays the source of truth.

Errors

Every error
says what to do.

Every error is JSON in one shape, {"error": {"code", "message"}}, and the message is written for people. A limit refusal adds error.limit and, for a limit you can change, error.manageUrl. Include the X-Request-Id of the response when you write to us.

The error codes with their HTTP status and meaning
CodeHTTPWhat it means
invalid_request400A field or parameter is missing or invalid; the message names it.
unauthorized401The key or token is missing, invalid or revoked. An MCP client signs in again.
insufficient_credits402The balance doesn’t cover this edit. GET /v1/account returns the link to buy credits in Aisma.
cap_reached402The key’s or app’s monthly credit limit, or its limit per edit, would be passed.
forbidden_scope403The key or app wasn’t given the scope this call needs.
not_found404No such upload, quote or edit on this account.
quote_expired409The quote is unknown, older than 15 minutes or already used. Ask for a new one.
preview_unavailable400This account has no preparation previews available. Request an ordinary edit quote.
preview_required409A new ChatGPT user must receive the preparation questions before the first edit starts. Use start_preview and present its questions.
not_ready409The finished video isn’t stored yet. Keep following the edit.
idempotency_mismatch409This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different body.
rate_limited429A limit refused the call and didn’t count it. Wait for Retry-After.
unavailable503Editing is briefly unavailable. Try again shortly.
internal500Something failed on Aisma’s side. Retry, or write to support with the X-Request-Id.

Questions developers ask

Before you
write the first call.

Does the API cost extra?

There is no separate API fee. An edit costs the same credits as in the app, Aisma shows the price before you start, and a quote is never charged. The current rates are on the pricing page.

Can the API buy credits?

No. The API never buys anything. When the balance is short, starting an edit answers 402 insufficient_credits, and GET /v1/account returns the link to top up in Aisma.

Which assistants can connect?

Any assistant or coding agent that supports remote MCP servers over Streamable HTTP, signing in with OAuth or sending an API key. Uploading a new clip needs one that can read your files; a chat-only assistant can re-edit the videos already in your Library.

Can I re-edit a video I already made?

Yes. POST /v1/assets/from-library, or use_library_video over MCP, takes a finished edit from your Library and makes it the source of a new one.

How long do result links last?

One hour. Ask for a new link whenever you need one; the video itself stays in your Library under the same rules as the edits you make in the app.

Are API edits private?

Yes. Uploads and results are private to your account and open only through signed, short-lived links. Section 8 of the terms covers the API and connected apps, and the privacy policy says how your data is handled.

Is there an SDK?

SDKs are on our roadmap. The OpenAPI 3.1 document describes every endpoint today, so most code generators can build a client from it.

Updated November 21, 2026

Building something bigger?
Tell us.

Write to support@aisma.ai about higher limits, batch work or the integration you have in mind.

Product questions are answered in the help center.

content_html_zh:
Aisma / For developers

The Aisma API and MCP server.Edit video from your code.

Scripts, automation tools and AI agents can edit a video you already shot, the way the app does: upload a clip of 2–60 seconds, describe the change in plain words, get the price in credits, start the edit and fetch the private result. It’s the same account, the same credits and the same Library as the app.

Read the OpenAPI referenceConnect an AI assistant

What stays

  • Your account, credits and Library
  • The app’s prices, quoted before you start
  • Your original framing and audio

有什么变化

  • Whatever your request asks for, in plain words
  • A face, a whole person, an outfit or a product
  • The background, a new style or an effect

What you bring

An Aisma account signed in with Google, Apple or email, credits, and a clip of 2–60 seconds (MP4 or MOV, up to 500 MB). Photos are optional, up to 10.

两种方式进入

One editor.Two ways to reach it.

How an edit runs

Upload, price, start.Then fetch the result.

An edit takes the same path in the app, over REST and over MCP. Nothing is charged until you start a quoted edit, and the finished video lands privately in your Library.

REST quickstart

Four steps.One edited clip.

Send your key as a bearer token and name your client in the User-Agent header. Bodies are JSON, ids are UUIDs and times are ISO 8601. The request below is the one behind the snowy forest at the top of this page.

# 1. Ask for an upload link
curl -X POST https://api.aisma.ai/v1/uploads \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AISMA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"kind":"video","contentType":"video/mp4","bytes":12345678}'
# Then PUT the file to uploadUrl with the headers it returns
curl -X PUT "$UPLOAD_URL" \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Content-Type: video/mp4" \
  --data-binary @clip.mp4

# 2. Price the edit once GET /v1/assets/ASSET_ID says ready (nothing is charged)
curl -X POST https://api.aisma.ai/v1/quotes \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AISMA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"sourceId":"ASSET_ID","brief":"change the background to a snowy forest","quality":"720p"}'

# 3. Start it; the Idempotency-Key makes a retry return the same edit
curl -X POST https://api.aisma.ai/v1/jobs \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AISMA_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Idempotency-Key: first-edit-0001" \
  -d '{"quoteId":"QUOTE_ID"}'

# 4. When GET /v1/jobs/JOB_ID says resultReady, get the one-hour link
curl -X POST https://api.aisma.ai/v1/jobs/JOB_ID/result \
  -A "my-app/1.0" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $AISMA_API_KEY"

While Aisma is still checking a new clip, a quote answers 202 with retryAfterMs; ask again after that delay. Follow an edit no more often than every 10 seconds, or register a webhook and wait for it.

MCP服务器

Connect your assistantwith one address.

Add https://api.aisma.ai/mcp as a remote MCP server or custom connector in any assistant or coding agent that supports them. The server speaks Streamable HTTP without sessions and answers the protocol revisions 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18 and 2025-03-26.

Setting up Claude, Cursor or VS Code? The video editing MCP server page walks through each client, every tool and what an agent can edit.

The first call opens Aisma’s sign-in page (OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration). There you choose what the connection may do and, if you like, a monthly credit limit; change its limits or disconnect it any time under Profile → Settings & help → Connected apps and keys.

Use Aisma in ChatGPT: start your prompt with “Aisma”, connect your Aisma account when ChatGPT prompts you the first time and attach a video with optional reference photos. Describe the edit and answer any preparation questions. Confirm the edit before it starts. You can also reuse a finished video from your Aisma Library.

MCP工具

Nine standard MCP tools.Confirm before credits.

Every tool has a title, read-only or destructive hints and an output schema, and answers with structured content. start_edit is marked destructive and tells the assistant to confirm the price with you first; asking it twice for the same quote returns the same edit.

The Aisma plugin in ChatGPT replaces create_upload with import_chat_media for files attached in the chat. When a preparation preview is available, start_preview and get_preview prepare the edit, answer_preview records your choices, and start_prepared_edit starts only after you confirm the edit. The ordinary quote path remains available when this account has no previews left.

登入

API keys or OAuth.Your caps either way.

Personal API keys: create one in the web app under Profile → Settings & help → Connected apps and keys. A key starts with aisma_live_ and is shown once; Aisma keeps only its hash. Send it in the Authorization header as Bearer aisma_live_…, never in a link.

Connected apps: MCP clients and other apps sign in with OAuth 2.1 (authorization code with PKCE, rotating refresh tokens and dynamic client registration). Discovery starts at https://api.aisma.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource.

Each key and connected app has its own scopes and limits. Revoke a key or disconnect an app and it stops working at once.

Keys and connected apps need an account signed in with Google, Apple or email. Guest profiles can’t hold them.

限制

What one editcan carry.

VideoOne clip of 2–60 seconds, up to 500 MB, MP4 or MOV, or a finished video from your Library.

PhotosUp to 10 per edit, JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 20 MB each. Call them “photo 1”, “photo 2” in the request.

RequestYour own words, up to 2,000 characters.

Result720p by default or 1080p, with your original framing and audio, private in your Library.

ContentAisma may refuse requests involving nudity or sexual content. An edit declined by this check is not charged: its issue has the code content_declined.

PriceCredits, as in the app, quoted before you start. Current rates are on the pricing page.

LimitsGenerous by default and yours to change per key or connected app: credit limits (none until you set one), edits started an hour, edits at once and uploads an hour (Library sources count), under Profile → Settings & help → Connected apps and keys. GET /v1/account returns the limits in effect and what is left. A refused call isn’t counted.

Daily uploadsEach account adds a set number of videos (Library sources count) and photos a day, more after buying credits.

HeadersEvery response carries X-Request-Id and Aisma-Version; limited calls add RateLimit-Limit, RateLimit-Remaining and RateLimit-Reset.

User-AgentPython's built-in urllib with its default User-Agent (Python-urllib/…) and Perl's libwww-perl default can be refused at the edge with HTTP 403 "error code: 1010": set your own User-Agent, such as my-app/1.0.

Version2026-10-19, in the Aisma-Version header.

网络钩子

Hear backwhen an edit is done.

Register an HTTPS endpoint with POST /v1/webhooks (scope webhooks:write). Aisma sends job.completed, job.failed and job.settled for the edits the API started.

Deliveries follow Standard Webhooks: each carries webhook-id, webhook-timestamp and webhook-signature, an HMAC-SHA256 of the id, the timestamp and the body, signed with the secret you get once when you register. A failed delivery is retried for up to 24 hours. Following the edit with GET /v1/jobs/{id} stays the source of truth.

错误

Every errorsays what to do.

Every error is JSON in one shape, {"error": {"code", "message"}}, and the message is written for people. A limit refusal adds error.limit and, for a limit you can change, error.manageUrl. Include the X-Request-Id of the response when you write to us.

The error codes with their HTTP status and meaning
CodeHTTP这意味着什么
invalid_request400A field or parameter is missing or invalid; the message names it.
unauthorized401The key or token is missing, invalid or revoked. An MCP client signs in again.
insufficient_credits402The balance doesn’t cover this edit. GET /v1/account returns the link to buy credits in Aisma.
cap_reached402The key’s or app’s monthly credit limit, or its limit per edit, would be passed.
forbidden_scope403The key or app wasn’t given the scope this call needs.
not_found404No such upload, quote or edit on this account.
quote_expired409The quote is unknown, older than 15 minutes or already used. Ask for a new one.
preview_unavailable400This account has no preparation previews available. Request an ordinary edit quote.
preview_required409A new ChatGPT user must receive the preparation questions before the first edit starts. Use start_preview and present its questions.
not_ready409The finished video isn’t stored yet. Keep following the edit.
idempotency_mismatch409This Idempotency-Key was already used with a different body.
rate_limited429A limit refused the call and didn’t count it. Wait for Retry-After.
unavailable503Editing is briefly unavailable. Try again shortly.
内部的500Something failed on Aisma’s side. Retry, or write to support with the X-Request-Id.

Questions developers ask

Before youwrite the first call.

Does the API cost extra?

There is no separate API fee. An edit costs the same credits as in the app, Aisma shows the price before you start, and a quote is never charged. The current rates are on the pricing page.

Can the API buy credits?

No. The API never buys anything. When the balance is short, starting an edit answers 402 insufficient_credits, and GET /v1/account returns the link to top up in Aisma.

Which assistants can connect?

Any assistant or coding agent that supports remote MCP servers over Streamable HTTP, signing in with OAuth or sending an API key. Uploading a new clip needs one that can read your files; a chat-only assistant can re-edit the videos already in your Library.

Can I re-edit a video I already made?

是的。 POST /v1/assets/from-library, or use_library_video over MCP, takes a finished edit from your Library and makes it the source of a new one.

How long do result links last?

One hour. Ask for a new link whenever you need one; the video itself stays in your Library under the same rules as the edits you make in the app.

Are API edits private?

是的。 Uploads and results are private to your account and open only through signed, short-lived links. Section 8 of the terms covers the API and connected apps, and the privacy policy says how your data is handled.

Is there an SDK?

SDKs are on our roadmap. The OpenAPI 3.1 document describes every endpoint today, so most code generators can build a client from it.
